gen-dafont-junegull-gf-cossette-texte: Chunky and cheerful: Junegull pinches its curves nearly shut, while Cossette Texte opens its lowercase e wide with a tall x-height. Long paragraphs in it move along with a steady, unfussy texture.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-gafata: Gafata reads tall and open, with a wide-eyed e, while Junegull pinches its curves nearly shut and feels retro and friendly. Text in Gafata stays light and quick to follow.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-georama: Georama loosens its c like a bracelet pulled apart and barely lifts its capitals, while Junegull stays closed, retro and friendly. Paragraphs flow low and level, with little to snag on.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-hind-guntur: Retro and friendly, Junegull pinches its curves shut, while Hind Guntur leaves wide gaps and draws tall, stamped-metal lowercase. The sharpest difference here is closed curves set against open ones.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums in a flat gray of constant line weight, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle. Hind Siliguri keeps long text quiet next to Junegull, whose closed curves feel retro and friendly.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-huninn: Junegull skips stroke contrast entirely and pinches every curve shut. Huninn keeps its s terminals clear and its lowercase near cap height, so the two trade closed shapes for open ones.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-miriam-libre: Wiry and open: Miriam Libre draws a wire-light s with generous openings, while Junegull pinches its curves nearly shut. Junegull brings the heft, and Miriam Libre the breathing room.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Tight-lipped and retro: Junegull pinches every curve, while Noto Kufi Arabic opens a welcoming gap in its c. Junegull grabs attention first and Noto Kufi Arabic keeps things moving.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-devanag: Junegull pinches every curve nearly shut and stands tall like cast iron capitals, while Noto Sans Devanagari keeps a compact, open skyline. Closed against open is the pair's whole argument.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-georgia: Chunky, retro, pinched at every curve. Junegull is best at grabbing attention with closed shapes, while Noto Sans Georgian is best at keeping open aperture curves easy to follow.
